steps.sql: SELECT n,CHAR(n) AS c,UNICODE(CHAR(n)) AS u,ASCII(CHAR(n)) AS a,DATALENGTH(CHAR(n)) AS bytes FROM (VALUES (-1),(0),(65),(128),(138),(142),(159),(208),(221),(222),(240),(253),(254),(255),(256)) v(n) ORDER BY n;
SELECT ASCII(N'Ğ' COLLATE Turkish_100_CI_AS) AS g,ASCII(N'İ' COLLATE Turkish_100_CI_AS) AS i,ASCII(N'😀' COLLATE Turkish_100_CI_AS) AS emoji;

SELECT n,CHAR(n) AS c,UNICODE(CHAR(n)) AS u,ASCII(CHAR(n)) AS a,DATALENGTH(CHAR(n)) AS bytes FROM (VALUES (-1),(0),(65),(128),(138),(142),(159),(208),(221),(222),(240),(253),(254),(255),(256)) v(n) ORDER BY n;
SELECT ASCII(N'Ğ' COLLATE Turkish_100_CI_AS_SC_UTF8) AS g,ASCII(N'İ' COLLATE Turkish_100_CI_AS_SC_UTF8) AS i,ASCII(N'😀' COLLATE Turkish_100_CI_AS_SC_UTF8) AS emoji;

CREATE TABLE t(id int PRIMARY KEY,s nvarchar(8) COLLATE Turkish_100_CI_AS); INSERT t VALUES(1,N'I'),(2,N'ı'),(3,N'i'),(4,N'İ'),(5,N'ş'),(6,N's'); SELECT s,COUNT(*) AS n FROM t GROUP BY s ORDER BY s; SELECT id FROM t WHERE s LIKE N'i' ORDER BY id; SELECT a.id,b.id AS other_id FROM t a JOIN t b ON a.s=b.s ORDER BY a.id,b.id; SELECT CHARINDEX(N'i',N'Iıiİ' COLLATE Turkish_100_CI_AS) AS pos,REPLACE(N'Iıiİ' COLLATE Turkish_100_CI_AS,N'i',N'x') AS replaced;
CREATE TABLE t(s varchar(8) COLLATE Turkish_100_BIN2); INSERT t VALUES(N'Ğ'),(N'İ'),(N'Ş'),(N'ğ'),(N'ı'),(N'ş'),(N'€'); SELECT s,CONVERT(varbinary(8),s) AS b FROM t ORDER BY s;

CREATE TABLE t(id int PRIMARY KEY,s nvarchar(8) COLLATE Turkish_100_CI_AS); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux ON t(s); INSERT t VALUES(1,N'I'),(2,N'i'); SELECT id FROM t WHERE s=N'ı'; SELECT id FROM t WHERE s=N'İ';
SELECT id,s FROM t ORDER BY s;
